name: eyevo
description: Pokemon Trading Card Game card data from Eyevo: find English, Japanese and Chinese cards, see current market and graded prices, price history, the most valuable cards in a set, and the value of a list of cards.

interface.longDescription:
Look up any Pokémon Trading Card Game card in English, Japanese or Chinese and see what it is worth. Eyevo finds cards by name, set or collector number (for example "Charizard 4/102"), shows the card with its current market price and a one-year price chart, and lists graded values from PSA, BGS, CGC and other graders.

You can also ask for the most valuable cards in a set or of a Pokémon, get details about a set, see how a card's price changed over the last year, and total the value of a list of cards, raw or graded. Every card links to its page on eyevotcg.com.

Prices come from public marketplace data (TCGplayer, Cardmarket, eBay and graded sales) and are guides, not offers.

Eyevo is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by The Pokémon Company, Nintendo, Game Freak or Creatures Inc. Pokémon and Pokémon character names are trademarks of Nintendo, The Pokémon Company and Game Freak; card images are shown for identification.

Most valuable cards in Evolving Skies
Show me the Japanese Umbreon VMAX from Eevee Heroes

positive.description: Value of a specific card, shown visually
positive.prompt: What is Charizard 4/102 from Base Set worth? Show me the card.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds base1-4 and shows the card widget with the image, TCGplayer market price, a one-year chart, graded prices and a View in Eyevo button; the reply adds short context without repeating the prices.

positive.description: Most valuable cards in a set
positive.prompt: What are the most valuable cards in Evolving Skies?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a ranked list widget of Evolving Skies cards with images and current prices, led by Umbreon VMAX #215; each row links to the card on eyevotcg.com.

positive.prompt: Show me the Japanese Umbreon VMAX from Eevee Heroes and what it is worth.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the Japanese catalog and shows an Eevee Heroes Umbreon VMAX card with its prices, labeled Japanese.

positive.prompt: How has the price of Charizard ex from 151, number 199, changed over the last year?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns monthly prices for the last year with the high and low and their dates, and summarizes the trend.

positive.prompt: I have two Charizard ex from 151 (#199) and one PSA 9 Base Set Charizard. What are they worth in total?
positive.expected_behavior: Prices each card (the graded one at its PSA 9 median) and reports a USD total.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Berlin tomorrow?
How much is a Black Lotus from Magic: The Gathering worth?
Sell my Charizard for me on eBay.

publication.release_notes: First release: card search, card details with prices and chart, most valuable cards, set details, price history and collection value for English, Japanese and Chinese Pokémon cards.
